filters.basis: The table holds six Sculptor group galaxies; these are the candidates around NGC 300.
Note 'cluster': a candidate whose spectrum confirmed it as a star cluster. The others are stars, galaxies, or have a weak spectrum or none.

frame.converter: Each sky position onto the midplane of the inclined disc the image layers are baked on (recipe.json), through the image-layer bake's own intersection.

discThickness.basis: The stellar disc's exponential scale height as its scale length over 7.3, the mean flattening Kregel et al. (2002) measured for edge-on discs, with S4G's disc scale length (Salo et al. 2015): 211 pc. The same thickness as the image layers' slabs; for young objects it is an upper value. Each row's own height is drawn, not measured.

meaning: Globular clusters of NGC 300 that Olsen et al.'s (2004) spectra confirmed among their candidates: one dot per cluster at its catalogue position.

appearance.note: Presentation only: the Milky Way globular clusters' warm orange. Each dot takes its tone and half its color from the photograph under it (packages/bake/cli/prepare-catalogue-points.mts).
